origin.description: Drop every cached result of a memoised function.
origin.details: Returns false when f is not memoised.
origin.value: True when the cache was cleared.
origin.example:
n <- 0
f <- function(x) { n <<- n + 1; x }
m <- memoise(f)
invisible(m(1))
invisible(forget(m))
invisible(m(1))
cat(paste(n), "\n", sep = "")

translation.description: Drop every cached result of a memoised function.
translation.details: Returns false when f is not memoised.
translation.value: True when the cache was cleared.
translation.example:
from memoise import *
n = {"n": 0}

def f(x):
    n["n"] += 1
    return x

m = memoise(f)
m(1)
forget(m)
m(1)
print(n["n"])
